hypothesis: In decode the Metal graph announces to the kernel the guessed experts of the next layer that are not in the cache, so the SSD reads them while the GPU works; announcing only the six likeliest instead of all eight leaves out the reads a step most often does not use, so decode steps 2 to 32 after a 512-token prompt of chat.txt get faster on an 8 GB M1, with the same logits.
model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration) converted to Colibri's qwen36 container: INT4 routed experts with gs=64 group scales, f16 dense weights (quantized to INT8 at load) and f16 embedding; 23 GB of safetensors; canonical.qc beside it (1.94 GB, written by qwen36-canonical) and experts.qc (17.1 GB, scales as 16-bit codes, the bytes qwen36-canonical --experts writes: its records written on 2026-10-05, its 8-byte stamp on 2026-10-07); the checkpoint's shards were written on 2026-09-16
command: for each version, git archive <its commit> c | tar -x -C <dir>, make -C <dir>/c qwen36_metal.o backend_metal.o METAL=1, then from the repository root, with the compiler flags make -C c qwen36 METAL=1 gives qwen36.c except its qpack path (-DQWEN36_QPACK and its objects, which the harness does not use): clang -O3 -Xclang -fopenmp -I<libomp>/include -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-unused-function -DCOLI_METAL -DQWEN36_METAL -I<dir>/c docs/experiments/qwen36-ahead-six-2026-10-06/bench.c <dir>/c/qwen36_metal.o <dir>/c/backend_metal.o -o <dir>/qwen36-bench -lm -L<libomp>/lib -lomp -framework Metal -framework Foundation -framework Accelerate -lc++; every run: /usr/bin/time -l env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$HOME SNAP=<model> <dir>/qwen36-bench chat.txt 64,512 32; baseline = a367db0c (the parent), trial = b16c23ca

hardware.cpu: Apple M1, 4 performance + 4 efficiency cores (MacBook Air, MacBookAir10,1, no fan)

config.SNAP: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Colibri qwen36 container, INT4 experts gs=64, internal SSD
config.BUILD: the compiler flags of make -C c qwen36 METAL=1 on macOS without its qpack path: clang -O3 -Xclang -fopenmp -DCOLI_METAL -DQWEN36_METAL, qwen36_metal.o and backend_metal.o
config.EXPERT_CACHE: the Metal graph's default: a sixteenth of the RAM (512 MiB, 303 slots of 1.77 MB in both versions)
config.PROMPT: the first 64 and the first 512 tokens of chat.txt (in this record: an English conversation written for these measurements, plain User:/Assistant: text without the chat template, 6,900 bytes read whole; prompt_hash is its SHA-256), each from an empty state; after each, 32 greedy tokens
config.ORDER: 1 warm-up run (baseline, discarded), then baseline trial trial baseline baseline trial trial baseline, one process each
config.REST: thermal state nominal, then 60 s, before every run
config.ANNOUNCED_GUESSES: the next layer's eight guessed experts (its top-k), those not in the cache (a367db0c)
config.MEASURED: tokens per second of the 32 tokens generated after the 512-token prompt (the first token excluded)

quality.method: FNV-1a fingerprint of every logit of the run, and the hash of the generated tokens, per prompt length: 64 tokens 250dc21c15a34ae4/5b90de6c0b996836, 512 tokens f0941d8725f04c2a/79ddc72edd15f604, the same in all nine runs (the warm-up and the 4 runs of each version)
